name: Clear QoS Policies
description: Removes all local Windows QoS policies to restore default packet prioritization after testing tweaks or removing outdated traffic rules.

description_i18n.en: Removes all local Windows QoS policies to restore default packet prioritization after testing tweaks or removing outdated traffic rules.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt alle lokalen Windows-QoS-Richtlinien, um die Standard-Paketpriorisierung wiederherzustellen, nachdem Tweaks getestet oder veraltete Verkehrsregeln entfernt wurden.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime toutes les stratégies QoS locales pour restaurer la priorisation des paquets par défaut après avoir testé des modifications ou supprimé des règles de trafic obsolètes.

warnings.title: Removes all traffic prioritization rules
warnings.message: This removes every local Windows Quality of Service policy, not just those added by this tool. Do not use if the system relies on these rules for VoIP, streaming applications, or managed network traffic

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Uses Get-NetQosPolicy and Remove-NetQosPolicy to remove local QoS policies from the Windows persistent policy store This is intended as a cleanup/reset action for local QoS rules created by tweaks or manual testing
